name: didit-authentication
description: Guidance for adding Didit end-user sign-in (hosted pages, passkeys, codes, social, SSO) to your app, with Didit documentation search. Configuration stays in the Didit console.

interface.shortDescription: Add Didit end-user sign-in to your app
interface.longDescription: Sign in with your Didit account to plan a Didit Authentication integration: choose sign-in methods, run the hosted flow with PKCE, validate tokens the way the docs specify and handle auth webhooks, with answers from the Didit documentation.
defaultPrompt: How do I add Didit sign-in with passkeys to my Next.js app?
How should my backend verify a Didit access token?
Which webhooks tell me about a sign-in from a new device?
